context.current_question: I am an international applicant interested in the Business Administration Graduate Certificate. Is it available to international applicants?
So does that automatically mean I'm admitted?
What can you actually verify, and what should I confirm with BCIT?

definitions.E8:
Yes. The Business Administration Graduate Certificate is available to international applicants.

International-specific points:

- A valid BCIT study permit is required before the program begins.
- A mandatory work component must be completed for graduation.
- The program is **not eligible for a Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP)** under its field-of-study classification.
- Certain international credentials require a course-by-course evaluation and GPA calculation.

[View the program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/business-administration-graduate-certificate-full-time-a700grcert/)

For more information, see BCIT International Students: https://www.bcit.ca/international-students/.
definitions.E4:
No. Being eligible to apply as an international applicant does **not** automatically mean you’re admitted.

Admission requires:

- A recognized bachelor’s degree in any field
- English proficiency equivalent to English Studies 12 with at least 67%
- Space in the program, since acceptance is first-qualified while seats remain

BCIT must also assess any required international credential evaluation and confirm admission. [View the program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/business-administration-graduate-certificate-full-time-a700grcert/)
definitions.E1:
**I can verify that:**

- The Business Administration Graduate Certificate is active, full-time, blended, and based at BCIT’s Downtown Campus.
- Admission criteria include a recognized bachelor’s degree and English Studies 12 at 67% or an equivalent.
- The curriculum has six required courses: **ECON 9100 Managerial Economics**, **FMGT 9152 Accounting for Managers**, **MKTG 9120 Marketing Management**, **FMGT 9260 Business Finance**, **GLBL 9200 Business Capstone Project**, and **OPMT 9170 Systems and Operations Management**.
- The September 2026 intake is closed; applications for September 2027 are scheduled to open October 1, 2026.

**Confirm with BCIT:**

- Whether your bachelor’s degree is recognized and requires a course-by-course evaluation or GPA calculation.
- Whether your English qualification is accepted as equivalent.
- Whether space remains and you have been admitted; acceptance is first-qualified while seats remain.
- The exact mandatory work-component and study-permit arrangements applicable to you.

[BCIT program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/business-administration-graduate-certificate-full-time-a700grcert/)
definitions.E5: Note: The September 2026 intake is now closed for new applications. Applications for the September 2027 intake will be accepted starting October 1, 2026. Delivery: blended. See details . In the BCIT Graduate Certificate in Business Administration you will gain practical business skills at a master’s level that can be applied across multiple industries. Graduates have the opportunity to continue their studies to complete a master’s degree or to enter the workforce in a managerial role. About the program The program incorporates a blend of assessments, including case studies, problem-based learning, collaborative group work, self-reflections, and individual projects. Students are exposed to real-world business issues throughout their coursework, culminating in a capstone project where students will be given the opportunity to work on solving real problems facing industry. Two terms to complete : Six graduate level courses taught over nine months (September to May) Blended course delivery : Evenings at the Vancouver campus combined with online learning Cohort program : You will work through this full-time program with your cohort, sharing your experience and expertise, and building a professional network that will last long after you have graduated Business capstone project : Students assume the role of a business professional and develop a report and presentation, addressing solutions to real-world industry challenges Laddering options : Articulations with partners are being developed so that alumni can ladder to master degree programs Master’s Degree Options The Graduate Certificate in Business Administration is structured to meet the requirements for direct entry and advanced placement in MBA programs. Learn more about the master pathways on the MBA Degree Options page. Next up Entrance Requirements
definitions.E6: Program length One academic year (nine months), full-time. Grading Students will be graded on a percentage scale. Courses must be passed with a 60% mark. Program delivery Blended: This program is delivered partly on campus and partly online. This program will be delivered in a hybrid/blended format with a combination of synchronous in-class and asynchronous online delivery. All courses will take place in classrooms at the BCIT Downtown Campus. Program location Downtown Campus 555 Seymour Street Vancouver, BC Online Learning Continue your education BCIT is currently working towards academic and transfer credit agreements with other educational institutions so that students can complete an MBA. When these are complete, a description of the academic credits available at each institution will be posted. It is expected that the first of these will be completed shortly.
